title: 雅思口语 Part 1–3 核心语块
goal: 围绕工作学习、家乡居住和科技社媒，给出具体经历与利弊，使用合适的自然搭配。
basis: 主题参考随应用分发的雅思题库，搭配练习参照 IELTS Speaking Band Descriptors 的词汇资源维度。例句与提示为原创。

units.title: 工作学习与技能成长
units.goal: 用具体经历回答学习方法、工作挑战和技能进步。

cards.en: It took me a few days to get the hang of the new software.
cards.zh: 我用了几天才摸到新软件的窍门。
cards.trigger_context: 刚接手新软件，练过几次后开始熟练。
cards.disambiguator: 强调一开始生疏，后来基本会用了。
cards.usage_boundary: 强调一开始生疏，后来基本会用了。
cards.feynman_hook: 强调一开始生疏，后来基本会用了。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 讲学会倒车入库的过程。
cards.transfer_example_en: It took a few lessons to get the hang of reverse parking.
cards.cloze_prompt: It took me a few days to [g__] [t__] [h___] [o_] the new software.

cards.en: My first few weeks in that job were a steep learning curve.
cards.zh: 做那份工作的头几周，我要学的东西特别多。
cards.trigger_context: 第一份工作得在很短时间学会许多新流程。
cards.disambiguator: 口语中常表示短期要学很多，难度较高。
cards.usage_boundary: 口语中常表示短期要学很多，难度较高。
cards.feynman_hook: 口语中常表示短期要学很多，难度较高。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 形容入门视频剪辑时的困难。
cards.transfer_example_en: Editing my first video was a steep learning curve.
cards.cloze_prompt: My first few weeks in that job were [a_] [s____] [l_______] [c____].

cards.en: I understood the theory, but the group project let me put it into practice.
cards.zh: 我懂了理论，小组项目让我把它用起来。
cards.trigger_context: 学了课堂上的沟通技巧，想在小组项目里真的试试。
cards.disambiguator: 从理解或计划转向实际运用。
cards.usage_boundary: 从理解或计划转向实际运用。
cards.feynman_hook: 从理解或计划转向实际运用。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 谈到学了节省开支的办法并用到生活里。
cards.transfer_example_en: I read about budgeting and put it into practice the next month.
cards.cloze_prompt: I understood the theory, but the group project let me [p__] [i_] [i___] [p_______].

cards.en: There wasn't much training, so I had to learn as I go.
cards.zh: 培训不多，所以我得边做边学。
cards.trigger_context: 找不到完整教程，你只能从一个小任务开始摸索。
cards.disambiguator: 靠实践逐步补足知识；可能仍会提前做部分准备。
cards.usage_boundary: 可能仍会提前做部分准备。
cards.feynman_hook: 靠实践逐步补足知识。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 讲自己种菜时如何学经验。
cards.transfer_example_en: I don't know much about gardening yet, so I learn as I go.
cards.cloze_prompt: There wasn't much training, so I had to [l____] [a_] [I_] [g_].

cards.en: I ask for feedback after training new staff.
cards.zh: 培训完新员工后，我会征求他们的反馈。
cards.trigger_context: 想知道自己给新员工讲解得清不清楚，请听众提意见。
cards.disambiguator: 主动请求具体意见；比自己猜效果更直接。
cards.usage_boundary: 比自己猜效果更直接。
cards.feynman_hook: 主动请求具体意见。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 为了练英语口语，请搭档指出一处最需要改进的地方。
cards.transfer_example_en: I ask for feedback on one thing after each practice call.
cards.cloze_prompt: I [a__] [f__] [f_______] after training new staff.

cards.en: A part-time job is a good way to pick up new skills.
cards.zh: 做兼职是学新技能的好办法。
cards.trigger_context: 在兼职中渐渐学会收银和处理订单。
cards.disambiguator: 可指通过接触或实践学会，语气比较自然。
cards.usage_boundary: 可指通过接触或实践学会，语气比较自然。
cards.feynman_hook: 可指通过接触或实践学会，语气比较自然。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 谈志愿活动能让人掌握什么。
cards.transfer_example_en: Volunteering at the festival helped me pick up new skills.
cards.cloze_prompt: A part-time job is a good way to [p___] [u_] [n__] [s_____].

cards.en: When an assignment looks huge, I break it down into smaller tasks.
cards.zh: 作业看起来太大时，我就把它拆成小任务。
cards.trigger_context: 作业太大无从下手，你先分成三个能完成的步骤。
cards.disambiguator: 拆分复杂任务或信息；重点是降低难度。
cards.usage_boundary: 重点是降低难度。
cards.feynman_hook: 拆分复杂任务或信息。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 收到长维修清单后做分步计划。
cards.transfer_example_en: Let's break it down into jobs we can finish this weekend.
cards.cloze_prompt: When an assignment looks huge, I [b____] [i_] [d___] into smaller tasks.

cards.en: I use a spreadsheet to keep track of my deadlines.
cards.zh: 我用表格记各项截止日期。
cards.trigger_context: 手上同时有几门课，用一个表格记截止日期。
cards.disambiguator: 持续追踪会变化或会忘记的信息。
cards.usage_boundary: 持续追踪会变化或会忘记的信息。
cards.feynman_hook: 持续追踪会变化或会忘记的信息。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 记录一周花了多少钱。
cards.transfer_example_en: I keep track of what I spend on food each week.
cards.cloze_prompt: I use a spreadsheet to [k___] [t____] [o_] my deadlines.

cards.en: I started to fall behind after I missed a week of classes.
cards.zh: 我缺了一周的课之后，进度就开始落后。
cards.trigger_context: 生病错过几节课，担心跟不上班级。
cards.disambiguator: 进度落在目标或别人后面；不只表示迟到一次。
cards.usage_boundary: 不只表示迟到一次。
cards.feynman_hook: 进度落在目标或别人后面。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 解释下雨为何可能拖慢施工进度。
cards.transfer_example_en: The builders might fall behind if it keeps raining.
cards.cloze_prompt: I started to [f___] [b_____] after I missed a week of classes.

cards.en: I check my list every morning to stay on top of smaller tasks.
cards.zh: 我每天早上看清单，把小事及时处理好。
cards.trigger_context: 同时有几件小事，你每天早上逐项处理。
cards.disambiguator: 持续掌握待办并及时处理；不等于地理位置在上面。
cards.usage_boundary: 不等于地理位置在上面。
cards.feynman_hook: 持续掌握待办并及时处理。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 讲保持及时回邮件的方法。
cards.transfer_example_en: I turn off most alerts so I can stay on top of urgent emails.
cards.cloze_prompt: I check my list every morning to [s___] [o_] [t__] [o_] smaller tasks.

cards.en: I set aside time to practise speaking after dinner.
cards.zh: 我会在晚饭后专门留时间练口语。
cards.trigger_context: 每天晚上刻意为口语练习留一小段时间。
cards.disambiguator: 在忙碌安排中主动保留一段时间。
cards.usage_boundary: 在忙碌安排中主动保留一段时间。
cards.feynman_hook: 在忙碌安排中主动保留一段时间。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 提议每周腾出时间和家人散步。
cards.transfer_example_en: I try to set aside time for a walk with my family.
cards.cloze_prompt: I [s__] [a____] [t___] to practise speaking after dinner.

cards.en: That job taught me to work under pressure without losing focus.
cards.zh: 那份工作让我学会了在压力下依然保持专注。
cards.trigger_context: 讲临近截止时如何保持清醒并优先处理大项。
cards.disambiguator: 描述压力条件下完成工作；不等同于喜欢压力。
cards.usage_boundary: 不等同于喜欢压力。
cards.feynman_hook: 描述压力条件下完成工作。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 描述忙时在餐饮店做兼职的经验。
cards.transfer_example_en: Working in a busy kitchen taught me to work under pressure.
cards.cloze_prompt: That job taught me to [w___] [u____] [p_______] without losing focus.

cards.en: We met every morning that week to meet a deadline.
cards.zh: 为了按时交付，那周我们每天早上碰头。
cards.trigger_context: 你解释小组在周五以前交完报告。
cards.disambiguator: 按既定期限交付；对应错过期限的 miss。
cards.usage_boundary: 对应错过期限的 miss。
cards.feynman_hook: 按既定期限交付。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 讲你为了按时交申请停止修改细节。
cards.transfer_example_en: I stopped polishing the last page so I could meet a deadline.
cards.cloze_prompt: We met every morning that week to [m___] [a_] [d_______].

cards.en: I made sure to pull my weight on the group project.
cards.zh: 我确保在小组项目里做好了自己的那一份。
cards.trigger_context: 小组里不想别人替你承担任务，你按分工完成。
cards.disambiguator: 为团队承担公平份额；有语义重心在责任。
cards.usage_boundary: 有语义重心在责任。
cards.feynman_hook: 为团队承担公平份额。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 合租时说自己也会参与公共区域清洁。
cards.transfer_example_en: I try to pull my weight by cleaning the kitchen twice a week.
cards.cloze_prompt: I made sure to [p___] [m_] [w_____] on the group project.

cards.en: I decided to take the initiative and make a welcome guide.
cards.zh: 我决定主动做一份入职指南。
cards.trigger_context: 发现新人反复迷路，没人安排时你主动做指引。
cards.disambiguator: 在别人提出要求前自己开始行动。
cards.usage_boundary: 在别人提出要求前自己开始行动。
cards.feynman_hook: 在别人提出要求前自己开始行动。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 同学都没人组织复习，于是你自愿开个群。
cards.transfer_example_en: I had to take the initiative and start a study group.
cards.cloze_prompt: I decided to [t___] [t__] [i_________] and make a welcome guide.

cards.en: I asked short questions at first to build up confidence.
cards.zh: 起初我先问简短的问题，慢慢建立信心。
cards.trigger_context: 你一开始不敢在会上发言，后来从问短问题练起。
cards.disambiguator: 强调信心经小练习累积；不是一下子变得自信。
cards.usage_boundary: 不是一下子变得自信。
cards.feynman_hook: 强调信心经小练习累积。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 第一次演讲前先对两位朋友试讲。
cards.transfer_example_en: I practised in front of two friends to build up confidence.
cards.cloze_prompt: I asked short questions at first to [b____] [u_] [c_________].

cards.en: I began to make steady progress once I practised a little every day.
cards.zh: 每天练一点后，我开始稳步进步。
cards.trigger_context: 你每周只加练一点，但几个月下来有明显变化。
cards.disambiguator: 指有规律的持续改善，不强调一次突破。
cards.usage_boundary: 指有规律的持续改善，不强调一次突破。
cards.feynman_hook: 指有规律的持续改善，不强调一次突破。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 讲自己练耐力跑量如何增加。
cards.transfer_example_en: I started to make steady progress when I kept my runs short and regular.
cards.cloze_prompt: I began to [m___] [s_____] [p_______] once I practised a little every day.

cards.en: Getting through my first presentation gave me a sense of achievement.
cards.zh: 顺利做完第一次展示，我有一种成就感。
cards.trigger_context: 你第一次不看笔记独立做完展示，感觉很有收获。
cards.disambiguator: 强调完成有挑战的事后内心的满足。
cards.usage_boundary: 强调完成有挑战的事后内心的满足。
cards.feynman_hook: 强调完成有挑战的事后内心的满足。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 修好以前不会修的旧自行车。
cards.transfer_example_en: Fixing my old bike gave me a sense of achievement.
cards.cloze_prompt: Getting through my first presentation gave me [a_] [s____] [o_] [a__________].

cards.en: I chose to write the outline so I could play to my strengths.
cards.zh: 我选择写提纲，好发挥自己的长处。
cards.trigger_context: 小组里你擅长组织信息，所以负责做提纲。
cards.disambiguator: 把职责安排到已有优势上；不是说只做容易的事。
cards.usage_boundary: 不是说只做容易的事。
cards.feynman_hook: 把职责安排到已有优势上。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 志愿活动中选自己擅长的签到沟通工作。
cards.transfer_example_en: Running the welcome desk let me play to my strengths.
cards.cloze_prompt: I chose to write the outline so I could [p___] [t_] [m_] [s________].

cards.en: I try to learn from my mistakes instead of hiding them.
cards.zh: 我尽量从错误中吸取经验，而不是把错误藏起来。
cards.trigger_context: 一次报告没讲明白，之后你重新安排了信息顺序。
cards.disambiguator: 发现失误的具体教训并以后调整做法。
cards.usage_boundary: 发现失误的具体教训并以后调整做法。
cards.feynman_hook: 发现失误的具体教训并以后调整做法。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 第一次烤面包失败，第二次改了烤箱温度。
cards.transfer_example_en: I had to learn from my mistakes and lower the oven temperature.
cards.cloze_prompt: I try to [l____] [f___] [m_] [m_______] instead of hiding them.

units.title: 家乡居住与社区变化
units.goal: 用生活细节描述住所、通勤和社区，展开利弊和变化。

cards.en: I grew up in a tight-knit community where neighbours helped each other.
cards.zh: 我在一个邻里相互帮忙、关系紧密的社区长大。
cards.trigger_context: 描述一个邻里互相认识、彼此帮忙的地方。
cards.disambiguator: 强调当地人熟悉并互助，不只指住得近。
cards.usage_boundary: 强调当地人熟悉并互助，不只指住得近。
cards.feynman_hook: 强调当地人熟悉并互助，不只指住得近。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 描述当地小渔村的居民相处方式。
cards.transfer_example_en: It's a tight-knit community, and people check on each other after storms.
cards.cloze_prompt: I grew up in [a_] [t____]-[k___] [c________] where neighbours helped each other.

cards.en: The street party helped me get to know my neighbours.
cards.zh: 街上的聚会让我慢慢认识了邻居。
cards.trigger_context: 搬家后参加街坊活动，慢慢熟悉周围的人。
cards.disambiguator: 强调逐渐熟悉；比只见过一面更深。
cards.usage_boundary: 比只见过一面更深。
cards.feynman_hook: 强调逐渐熟悉。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 因为每天遛狗开始结识邻居。
cards.transfer_example_en: Walking the dog is how I get to know my neighbours.
cards.cloze_prompt: The street party helped me [g__] [t_] [k___] [m_] [n_________].

cards.en: Having a café I knew made me feel at home in the new city.
cards.zh: 有一家熟悉的咖啡馆让我在新城市感觉自在。
cards.trigger_context: 刚搬到新城市，有熟悉的小店让你越来越自在。
cards.disambiguator: 强调自己感到放松、有归属感；不要求真在家。
cards.usage_boundary: 不要求真在家。
cards.feynman_hook: 强调自己感到放松、有归属感。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 描述寄宿家庭如何让你放松。
cards.transfer_example_en: They invited me to cook with them, which helped me feel at home.
cards.cloze_prompt: Having a café I knew made me [f___] [a_] [h___] in the new city.

cards.en: I live in a quiet residential area near a small park.
cards.zh: 我住在一个安静的居民区，旁边有个小公园。
cards.trigger_context: 介绍住所的位置，表明周边主要是住家。
cards.disambiguator: 说明区域用途和氛围；不暗示离市区远。
cards.usage_boundary: 不暗示离市区远。
cards.feynman_hook: 说明区域用途和氛围。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 解释图书馆周边为何晚上安静。
cards.transfer_example_en: The library is in a quiet residential area, so it's very peaceful at night.
cards.cloze_prompt: I live [i_] [a_] [q____] [r__________] [a___] near a small park.

cards.en: The buses run so often that it's easy to get around.
cards.zh: 公交发车很勤，所以在城里出行很方便。
cards.trigger_context: 评价城市交通时提到公交密、换乘简单。
cards.disambiguator: 说在城区各处移动容易；涵盖公共交通或步行。
cards.usage_boundary: 涵盖公共交通或步行。
cards.feynman_hook: 说在城区各处移动容易。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 说明旅游小岛骑车就能逛遍。
cards.transfer_example_en: It's easy to get around the island by bike.
cards.cloze_prompt: The buses run so often that it's [e___] [t_] [g__] [a_____].

cards.en: I'd like the area to be well connected by public transport.
cards.zh: 我希望这片区域的公交和轨道交通连接良好。
cards.trigger_context: 介绍理想居住区，希望公交或铁路线路接得上。
cards.disambiguator: 在交通语境下指网络连接好；不指人脉。
cards.usage_boundary: 不指人脉。
cards.feynman_hook: 在交通语境下指网络连接好。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 谈卫星城想吸引就业，需要便捷接入高铁。
cards.transfer_example_en: For the town to grow, it needs to be well connected by rail.
cards.cloze_prompt: I'd like the area to [b_] [w___] [c________] by public transport.

cards.en: My flat is a short walk from the subway station.
cards.zh: 我家离地铁站走几步就到。
cards.trigger_context: 向考官说明自己从家走到地铁站很近。
cards.disambiguator: 用步行距离表达两地接近；不要求有精确分钟数。
cards.usage_boundary: 不要求有精确分钟数。
cards.feynman_hook: 用步行距离表达两地接近。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 介绍住处与海滩的距离。
cards.transfer_example_en: The guesthouse was a short walk from the beach.
cards.cloze_prompt: My flat is [a_] [s____] [w___] [f___] the subway station.

cards.en: My old flat was right in the middle of the city.
cards.zh: 我以前的公寓就在市中心。
cards.trigger_context: 描述公寓位于闹市核心区。
cards.disambiguator: 突出位置非常居中，也可说处于某事件中。
cards.usage_boundary: 突出位置非常居中，也可说处于某事件中。
cards.feynman_hook: 突出位置非常居中，也可说处于某事件中。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 描述市场位于镇广场中央。
cards.transfer_example_en: The farmers' market is right in the middle of the square.
cards.cloze_prompt: My old flat was [r____] [i_] [t__] [m_____] [o_] the city.

cards.en: What I liked about that town was a slower pace of life.
cards.zh: 我喜欢那个镇上的慢节奏。
cards.trigger_context: 比较小城与大城市，觉得小城的日常没那么赶。
cards.disambiguator: 评价整体生活节奏；不是单指交通更慢。
cards.usage_boundary: 不是单指交通更慢。
cards.feynman_hook: 评价整体生活节奏。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 讲为什么假期喜欢在渔村住。
cards.transfer_example_en: A fishing village offers a slower pace of life during the holidays.
cards.cloze_prompt: What I liked about that town was [a_] [s_____] [p___] [o_] [l___].

cards.en: They removed a car park to make room for a playground.
cards.zh: 他们拆掉一个停车场，为游乐场腾地方。
cards.trigger_context: 旧停车场拆掉改建公园，谈社区变化。
cards.disambiguator: 释放实体或抽象空间给新的用途。
cards.usage_boundary: 释放实体或抽象空间给新的用途。
cards.feynman_hook: 释放实体或抽象空间给新的用途。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 重新摆放书桌为共享空间留位置。
cards.transfer_example_en: We moved two desks to make room for a meeting table.
cards.cloze_prompt: They removed a car park to [m___] [r___] [f__] a playground.

cards.en: The neighbourhood has plenty of green spaces where people can exercise.
cards.zh: 这个社区有不少能供人运动的绿地。
